provider: Alibaba Cloud Agent Sandbox / FC / AgentRun

free_tier.stated: no credit and no free compute; the only free allowance is 15 GiB of sandbox disk, and it is withdrawn while an instance is deep-asleep or snapshot-saved

interface_detail: an API, per the billing overview page: "自定义模板可通过 API 主动预热（Template Cache），减少沙箱首次启动耗时。"

limits.value: vCPU, memory and disk are billed per second by QoS tier; the page's own example is '不足 1 秒按 1 秒计算'
15 GiB of free rootfs disk while active or shallow-asleep; deep sleep and snapshots lose it
shallow sleep is entered automatically below 0.01 core of CPU, below 1,000 bytes a second of network, or with no request; deep sleep keeps memory in a snapshot and bills the storage

identity_cost.detail: a China-site Alibaba Cloud account: registration needs a mobile number that can receive an SMS code, '注册前只需要准备一个...可以接收短信验证码的手机号码...即可，注册账号流程相同。', and '注册完成后，在充值和购买云产品之前需要完成账号的实名认证'. Individual verification takes '输入个人认证的姓名和身份证号码，开始认证，个人身份校验成功后进行扫脸', that is a name, an identity-card number and a face scan. The sandbox bills per second from the account balance ('账户余额不足导致欠费时，系统将发送欠费通知'), so the real-name check comes before use.

confidence_note: the billing overview was read on 2026-10-22 (help.aliyun.com, Chinese). It prices three lifecycle states separately and states a 15 GiB free disk allowance. There is no free compute allowance, so the free tier is the disk and the record says so

evidence.proved: three states priced separately: '活跃' bills vCPU, memory and disk; '深休眠' snapshots the whole instance including memory to persistent storage and bills disk only; '浅休眠' bills memory and disk and is entered automatically when 'CPU 消耗 < 0.01 core', '网络流量 < 1,000 Bytes/s' or '无请求触发'; and '磁盘享受 15 GiB 免费额度'. Deep sleep loses the 15 GiB free disk…

session_cap.note: no vendor wall-clock cap: the caps are user-set. The automatic transition is shallow sleep, triggered by the same activity test Azure uses: under 0.01 core of CPU, under 1,000 bytes a second, or no request

ps.price: billed per GiB-second past the 15 GiB allowance
ps.durability: rootfs; a deep-sleep snapshot holds memory as well as disk
ps.retention: until destroyed; a snapshot persists while it is billed
